altJa: 薄い褐色の皮に包まれた、丸みのある不規則な形のジャガイモ二個のイラスト。表面には小さなくぼみがあります。
observationJa: 丸みのある全体の形と、皮の表面にある目と呼ばれるくぼみを見ます。
limitJa: 一般的な外観を学ぶための一例です。この図だけで品種・品質・食用の適否・病害を判定したり、芽や緑色の部分の処理方法を決めたりはしません。

generation.exactPrompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Create an original botanical 2D illustration for a Japanese agriculture learning app: two whole mature unpeeled potatoes, one slightly larger and round-irregular and the other oval-irregular. Warm light tan/light brown thin skin with small shallow eye dimples, subtle natural mottling and soft painted texture. Neither potato is cut or peeled. Gentle naturalistic painted botanical style matching warm ivory-background crop flashcards. Soft even illumination, minimal soft contact shadows, a plain warm ivory background, no basket, no earth, no leaves, no tools. Center both potatoes with generous margins, complete unclipped outlines; slight separation so both shapes are visible. No sprouts, no green patches, no disease lesions, no exaggerated deep holes. No embedded labels, letters, numbers, watermark, measurement marks or safety symbols. This is an illustrative common-appearance example, not an image diagnosing quality, cultivar or edibility. Entirely original composition; no book photograph as input.
